LanguageData.Geopol_cheeseburger.label: cheeseburger
LanguageData.Geopol_cheeseburger.description: A cheeseburger is a sandwich made up of two round buns, topped with ground beef, raw vegetables (salad, tomato, onion, pickle), with a slice of cheese, and sauce.
LanguageData.Geopol_fondue.label: cheese dip
LanguageData.Geopol_fondue.description: A cheese dip, or "fondue", is a Swiss culinary specialty consisting of dipping pieces of bread into a container of melted cheese mixed with beer.
LanguageData.Geopol_baguette.label: Baguette
LanguageData.Geopol_baguette.description: A baguette is a variety of bread, recognizable by its elongated shape, emblematic of France.
LanguageData.Geopol_pizza.label: pizza
LanguageData.Geopol_pizza.description: Pizza is a traditional cooking recipe of Italian cuisine, originating in Naples, based on a flatbread of bread dough, topped with various mixtures of ingredients (tomato sauce, sun-dried tomatoes, vegetables, cheese, cold cuts, olives, olive oil…) and baked.
